1. (Currently amended) A composition comprising an active ingredient which is a compound of formula I

__wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9 and R10 are each independently selected from hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, aryl, aryloxy, heteroaryl, heteroaryloxy, wherein the alkyl, alkoxy, aryl, aryloxy, heteroaryl and heteroaryloxy groups may be substituted,__

and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0,00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim __3__, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__.

6. (Original) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for treating skin diseases__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation __selected from acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, other defects of keratinisation selected from ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component selected from all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums__.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for __treating conditions related to__ hair care and/or hair follicle development.

10. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment for__ care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair.

11. (Original) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the __active ingredient according to__ Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

13. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment of__ [[prophylaxis against or reduction of]] skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment of__ [[prophylaxis against]] time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair __selected from dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin__.
